text:
ANTIFRAUD::disable_auto_transactions
Description
This command disables automatic transactions for the current
transaction.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_auto_transactions
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
header
exists
"Antifraud-Disable-AutoTransactions"
]
}
{
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_auto_transactions
log
local0.
"Automatic Transactions disabled"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_REQUEST
